April · May

The car and golf cart you leave behind

Every spring, snowbirds from Clearwater Beach to Palm Harbor drop the Buick and the cart here before heading north. Battery tender stays on; the car starts in November.

  • Vehicle & RV parking, open or covered
  • Gate code works 6 a.m. – 9 p.m.
  • Month-to-month, refund unused days

CLIMATE CONTROL

No mildew on the wood or the leather

Air-conditioned hallways hold the air steady so condo furniture, artwork and anything that hates salt air comes back the way it went in. Wood, fabric and paper pick up mildew in a Florida summer without it.
